verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is a single product-page line saying Rovo models can be accessed 'in your terminal', which implies a first-party terminal tool. Nothing shows it is a Bitbucket CLI for repos, PRs or pipelines, and it is not named or documented. The MCP server is a separate capability and is not credited here. Missing for 10: a named and documented official Bitbucket CLI, commands for repo/PR/pipeline operations, install and auth docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
